Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)

This visa is for invited workers and New Zealand citizens with skills we need, to live and work permanently anywhere in Australia.

Eligibility

To apply for this visa you must be invited to apply. You must also meet the basic requirements below.

Age requirement

Applicants must be under 45 years of age at the time of invitation.

Work experience

Applicants must have at least three (3) years of relevant full-time work experience in a nominated skilled occupation.

English language

Applicants must have competent English or an approved equivalent test result.

Points test

You must score at least 65 points on the points test to be eligible to submit an expression of interest.

FactorPoints

Required documents

  • Valid passport
  • Skills assessment
  • English test result
